blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. Generative AI offers new ways to realize these choices, raising questions about explanatory clarity and purposeful visual expression. We examine these questions through a visual retrospective of 371 motivation and framework figures from 200 papers. The corpus comprises a quota-based main sample of 160 papers spanning four temporal periods and a separate purposive style-contrast sample of 40 papers. A single multimodal judge evaluates six dimensions of communication and design, with three repeated judgments per figure. We attempt source-constrained revisions of all 371 figures, of which 369 pass the recorded fidelity checks. Original-figure ratings show no uniform decline across periods. Revisions increase mean clarity ratings by 0.428 points and decrease aesthetic coherence ratings by 0.111 points on a five-point scale. Gains in the six-dimension average are larger for main-sample motivation figures than for frameworks. Case analyses show that added explanation can clarify comparisons while leaving typographic hierarchy and visual economy unresolved. These model-based findings support researcher-led design, with AI assisting exploration and authors retaining responsibility for explanatory purpose, composition, and scientific relationships. The accompanying atlas and evaluation records are available at https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html.
blocks.zh: 科学人物通过抽象、组成和强调的选择,赋予研究思想一种视觉形式。 基因AI提供了实现这些选择的新方法,提出了解释性清晰度和有目的的视觉表达问题. 我们通过对200篇论文中的371个动机和框架数字的直观回顾来审查这些问题。 这份文书包括一份基于配额的主要样本,共160篇论文,涉及四个时间段,还有一份有目的的风格-冲突样本,涉及40篇论文。 单一的多式联运法官对通信和设计的六个方面进行评价,每个数字有三次重复判决。 我们试图对所有371个数字进行来源限制的修订,其中369个数字通过了记录的忠诚度检查。 原图收视率显示各个时期没有统一下降. 修订后将平均清晰度的评分增加0.428分,在5分尺度上将审美一致性的评分减少0.11分. 六分法平均收益主要动机数字大于框架。 案例分析显示,附加解释可以澄清比较,而排印结构与视觉经济则无法解决。 这些基于模型的调查结果支持研究人员主导的设计,AI协助勘探,作者保留解释目的、组成和科学关系的责任。 随附的地图集和评价记录见https://ntu-ai4x.github.io/Rethinking_Figures/index_en.html。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A familiar scene unfolds before many paper deadlines. The manuscript is almost ready, yet Figure 1 remains open on the screen. An arrow is rerouted, a color is given a clearer meaning, and a generic box gives way to an example that reveals the central idea. Such revisions help shape the scientific argument. They influence what a reader notices, which relationships become intelligible, and how a contribution is remembered. The nights recalled in our title represent this effort to find a visual form that belongs to a particular idea.
blocks.zh: 一个熟悉的场景在很多纸质期限之前展开. 手稿几乎已经准备好,然而图1仍然在屏幕上开放. 一个箭头被重新排列,一个颜色被赋予更明确的含义,一个通用的盒子让位给一个揭示中心思想的例子. 这种修改有助于形成科学论点。 它们影响读者所注意到的,哪些关系变得易懂,如何记住一项贡献。 我们标题中回顾的夜晚代表了为寻找属于某个特定想法的视觉形式所作的努力。

blocks.en: Teaser and framework figures serve complementary roles in this process. A teaser may introduce a problem, expose a limitation, or communicate an insight, while a framework figure presents the organization of a method. Our study focuses on motivation-oriented teasers and overall frameworks. Three familiar framework diagrams illustrate how composition can expose scientific structure. U-Net uses a U-shaped arrangement to express contraction, expansion, and cross-scale transfer. The Transformer organizes its principal operations around the relationship between an encoder and a decoder, while CLIP places contrastive pretraining alongside zero-shot classification [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Fig. 1 presents these deliberately selected landmarks as qualitative reference points outside the analytical corpus. Their value here lies in the correspondence between visual arrangement and scientific structure.
blocks.zh: 茶瑟和框架人物在这一过程中起到互补作用。 取笑者可能提出问题、暴露限制或传达见解,而框架图则提出方法的组织。 我们的研究侧重于以动机为导向的取笑者和总体框架。 三个熟悉的框架图说明了组成如何暴露科学结构。 U-Net使用U形的安排来表达收缩,扩张,以及跨尺度的转移. "变形器"围绕编码器与解码器之间的关系组织主要操作,而CLIP则将对比性预训与零镜头分类[1,2,3]并列. 图1将这些故意选定的地标作为分析体以外的质量参考点。 这里它们的价值在于视觉安排和科学结构之间的对应.
(b) CLIP(2021年)。

blocks.en: Generative models broaden the ways in which researchers develop such compositions. They can propose layouts, create illustrative elements, and support iterative refinement. Recent systems also target scientific diagrams explicitly [ 4 ] . This assistance makes alternative designs easier to explore, but authors must still decide which arrangement best explains the intended claim. An attractive draft may obscure a dependency, repeat information, or give a secondary detail undue prominence. Additional labels may resolve ambiguity while increasing reading effort. Assessing AI assistance therefore requires examining how revisions affect communication, visual economy, and scientific fidelity.
blocks.zh: 基因模型拓宽了研究人员发展这种成分的方法. 它们可以提出布局,创造说明性要素,并支持迭代完善. 最近的系统还明确针对科学图[4]。 这种协助使其他设计更易于探索,但作者仍必须决定哪种安排能最好地解释预期的主张。 具有吸引力的草案可能会掩盖依赖性,重复信息,或者给予次要细节不应有的重视。 额外的标签可能会解决模糊性,同时增加阅读努力. 因此,评估大赦国际的援助需要审查修订如何影响通信、视觉经济和科学忠诚。

blocks.en: Visual appearance alone cannot establish how a figure was produced or how effectively it communicates. Likewise, an overall quality score can conceal improvements in clarity that coincide with weaker organization or aesthetic coherence. A useful assessment must distinguish production provenance from visible design properties and examine communication through multiple dimensions. This motivates an analysis that places existing figures in their historical context and follows changes within individual figures.
blocks.zh: 仅凭视觉外观无法确定一个数字是如何生成的,也无法确定它是如何有效沟通的。 同样,总体质量得分可以掩盖与较弱的组织或美学一致性相吻合的改进情况。 有用的评估必须区分生产来源和明显的设计特性,并通过多个维度审查通信。 这推动了一种分析,将现有数字置于其历史背景中,并随着个别数字的变化。

blocks.en: Within this multidimensional assessment, we give particular attention to purposeful visual inventiveness and problem-specific design . A revealing comparison, a meaningful spatial correspondence, or a carefully organized example can make an unfamiliar concept accessible. These qualities can appear in a restrained block diagram or a detailed illustration, depending on the message and audience [ 5 ] . They give a concrete interpretation to the “human touch” that motivates this study without treating appearance as evidence of authorship or effort. A polished figure can still leave its central claim implicit, and a detailed diagram can identify its components without making their interactions traceable.
blocks.zh: 在这一多层面评估中,我们特别关注有目的的视觉发明和针对具体问题的设计。 一个揭示性的比较、有意义的空间通信或精心组织的例子,可以使不熟悉的概念成为无障碍。 这些品质可以出现在受约束的块图或详细的插图中,这取决于信息与受众[5]. 它们具体解释“人类触摸”促使这项研究,而不把外表视为作者或努力的证据。 抛光的数字仍然可以隐含其中心主张,一个详细的图表可以识别其组成部分,而不会使其相互作用可以追踪。

blocks.en: Evidence from other creative activities further highlights the distinction between individual evaluations and collective diversity. Doshi and Hauser report improved individual evaluations of AI-assisted stories alongside greater similarity among outputs [ 6 ] . Ashkinaze et al. find that extensive exposure to AI-generated ideas increases collective diversity without improving individual creativity [ 7 ] . These task-dependent findings motivate distinguishing communicative quality, expressive design, and stylistic diversity. Our evaluation addresses the first two, while claims about community-wide stylistic convergence require separate evidence.
blocks.zh: 其他创造性活动的证据进一步突出了个别评价和集体多样性之间的区别。 Doshi和Hauser的报告改进了对AI辅助故事的个别评价,同时增加了产出之间的相似性。 Ashkinaze等人发现,广泛接触AI产生的想法会增加集体多样性,而不提高个人的创造力[7]. 这些取决于任务的调查结果促使人们区分沟通的质量、表达式设计和风格多样性。 我们的评价涉及前两项,而关于全社区结构趋同的说法则需要单独的证据。

blocks.en: We combine a retrospective analysis of existing figures with a source-constrained revision study. The corpus contains 371 figures from 200 papers, including a quota-based main sample of 160 papers spanning four periods and a separate purposive style-contrast sample of 40 papers. A fixed protocol uses a single multimodal judge to assess six dimensions of communication and design (Section 2 ). Under this protocol, original-figure ratings show no uniform deterioration across periods. Revisions receive higher mean clarity ratings but lower aesthetic-coherence ratings, with larger increases in the six-dimension average for main-sample motivation figures than for frameworks. Case analyses connect these outcomes to specific design decisions, particularly the balance between making explanations explicit and preserving a coherent composition.
blocks.zh: 我们把对现有数字的回顾性分析与受来源限制的修订研究结合起来。 调查书载有200份论文中的371份数字,包括一份基于配额的主要样本,共160份,涉及四个时期,还有一份有目的的风格-冲突样本,涉及40份论文。 固定协议使用单一的多式联运法官来评估通信和设计的六个方面(第2节)。 根据这一协议,原图的评级显示不同时期之间没有统一的恶化. 修订得到的平均清晰度较高,但审美一致性评级较低,主要抽样动机数字的六分法平均值增幅大于框架。 案例分析将这些结果与具体的设计决定联系起来,特别是明确解释和保持连贯的构成之间的平衡。

blocks.en: This study makes three contributions: 1. We construct a traceable corpus and illustrated atlas of 200 papers and 371 figures, retaining source and visual-version evidence and distinguishing the main sample from the purposive contrast sample. 2. We evaluate original figures and 369 study-generated revisions that pass the recorded fidelity checks across six dimensions, preserving repeated judgments and reporting both dimension-level tradeoffs and fidelity failures. 3. We develop practical guidance for researcher-led figure design, connecting observed tradeoffs to decisions about visual narrative, typographic hierarchy, information selection, and scientific fidelity.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有三项贡献: 1. 我们绘制了一份可追踪的书目和200篇论文和371个数字的图表图,保留了来源和可视化证据,并将主要样本与目的对比样本区分开来。 2. 我们评价原始数字和369项研究产生的修订,这些修订将记录的忠诚度检查通过六个层面,保留重复的判断,并报告维度一级的权衡和忠诚度的失败。 3. 我们为研究人员主导的数字设计制定实用指南,将观察到的权衡与视觉叙事、排版结构、信息选择和科学忠诚性的决定联系起来。

blocks.en: 2 Study Overview and Research Questions
blocks.zh: 2. 研究概况和研究问题

blocks.en: Our scope: assistance without surrendering design Design principle. Researchers should determine what a figure communicates and how its composition, colors, symbols, and connections express the scientific idea. Study approach. We combine a retrospective analysis of existing figures with paired assessment of source-constrained revisions, documenting both design tradeoffs and fidelity failures. Evaluation focus. Six dimensions characterize visual communication and design under a fixed multimodal judging protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们的范围:援助而不放弃设计原则。 研究者应该确定一个数字沟通的内容,以及其构成,颜色,符号,和连接如何表达科学思想. 学习方法。 我们把对现有数字的回顾性分析与对来源限制的修订的对等评估结合起来,记录了设计上的权衡和忠诚的失败。 评价重点。 根据固定的多式联运判断协议,视觉通信和设计有六个层面的特点。

blocks.en: The study distinguishes visual appearance, production provenance, and communication quality. Appearance can be inspected directly, while provenance requires evidence about how a figure was produced. We assess communication and design through six dimensions: Communicative Clarity, Organization and Readability, Graphical Consistency, Aesthetic Coherence, Purposeful Visual Inventiveness, and Design Specificity. The latter two respectively assess whether a visual device contributes to explanation and whether the depicted elements and relationships are specific to the research problem. These dimensions are examined separately to preserve tradeoffs that an overall score may conceal.
blocks.zh: 该研究区分了视觉外观,生产出处,以及通信质量. 外观可以直接检查,而出处则需要有关数字是如何生成的证据. 我们通过六个方面评估通信和设计: 交流性清晰度,组织和可读性,图形一致性,审美一致性,目的性视觉创新,以及设计特性. 后两者分别评估视觉设备是否有助于解释,以及所描绘的内容和关系是否与研究问题具体有关. 对这些维度进行单独审查,以保持总得分可能掩盖的权衡。

blocks.en: Two research questions guide the analysis: RQ1. How do communication and design ratings vary across periods and figure roles? The retrospective analysis compares motivation and framework figures across the four periods within the main sample. The purposive contrast sample supports closer examination of selected visual conventions and is analyzed separately. RQ2. How do these ratings change following source-constrained AI-assisted revision? Paired comparisons identify gains, losses, and unchanged ratings across dimensions. Revisions that fail fidelity checks are retained as workflow outcomes without receiving quality scores.
blocks.zh: 两个研究问题指导了分析: RQ1. 沟通和设计评级如何因时期和人物角色而异? 追溯分析比较了主要样本内四个期间的动机和框架数字。 目的对比样本支持更仔细地审查选定的视觉公约,并分别进行分析。 RQ2 (英语). 这些评级在源码限制的AI辅助修订后有何变化? 预测的比较确定不同层面的利得、损失和无变化的评级。 未能完成忠诚度检查的修订保留为工作流程结果,而不获得质量分数。

blocks.en: Both questions are descriptive and concern the documented corpus and configured evaluator. The fixed protocol provides a standardized assessment procedure, while the correspondence between its ratings and human understanding or preference remains to be established [ 8 ] . These analyses inform our argument for researcher-led design and identify questions for subsequent reader studies.
blocks.zh: 这两个问题都是描述性的,涉及有文件记载的委托书和配置的评价员。 固定协议提供了一个标准化的评估程序,而其评级与人类理解或偏好之间的对应关系仍有待确定[8]. 这些分析为研究者主导的设计提供了依据,并为以后的读者研究确定了问题。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 3 数据集建设

blocks.en: We constructed a traceable corpus of 200 papers and 371 motivation and framework figures through two complementary collection paths. The quota-based main sample contains 160 papers and 320 figures for comparisons across temporal stages and research topics. A separate purposive style-contrast sample contains 40 papers and 51 figures for examining selected visual conventions. Papers are the units of inclusion and deduplication, while figures are the units of assessment. Eligible material was publicly available by 20 October 2026, and collection was finalized on 29 October 2026. The sampling procedure was refined through pilot collection and checks of candidate availability and was not preregistered.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个互补的收集途径,构建了200份文件和371个动机和框架数字的可追踪资料库。 以配额为基础的主要样本包括160篇论文和320份数字,供在时间阶段和研究专题之间进行比较。 一个单独的有目的的风格-相容样本包含40篇论文和51位数字,用于审查选定的视觉公约. 文件是纳入和重复的单位,而数字是评估单位。 合格材料于2026年10月20日前公开发行,收藏于2026年10月29日定稿. 通过试点收集和检查候选人的提供情况,改进了取样程序,但没有预先登记。

blocks.en: 3.1 Sampling Design: Stages, Topics, and Sources
blocks.zh: 3.1 取样设计:阶段、主题和来源

blocks.en: The main sample crosses four temporal stages with four research topics that recur throughout the study period (Fig. 2 ). Object detection primarily concerns 2D objects, while image segmentation includes semantic and instance segmentation. Image restoration covers denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution, and 3D vision primarily concerns reconstruction. Each of the 16 combinations of stage and topic contains 10 papers, with each paper contributing one motivation (M) figure and one distinct framework (F) figure. These quotas maintain a common topical scope while accommodating changes in methods and subtopics within each research area.
blocks.zh: 主要样本跨越四个时间阶段,四个研究课题在整个研究期间反复出现(图2)。 对象检测主要涉及2D对象,而图像分割包括语义和实例分割. 图像修复包括解雾、破解和超解,3D视觉主要涉及重建。 阶段和专题的16个组合中,每个组合包含10篇论文,每篇论文贡献一个动机(M)图和一个不同的框架(F)图. 这些配额保持共同的专题范围,同时顾及每个研究领域方法和分专题的变化。

blocks.en: The eligibility window extends from 1 January 2016 to 20 October 2026. The public releases of ChatGPT on 30 November 2022, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image (Nano Banana) on 26 August 2025, and ChatGPT Images 2.0 (GPT Image 2) on 21 April 2026 mark the beginnings of S2, S3, and S4, respectively [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Each preceding stage ends on the previous day. Stage assignment follows public evidence for the sampled visual version. These milestones indicate tool availability and do not establish use by the original authors.
blocks.zh: 资格窗口从2016年1月1日延长至2026年10月20日. 2022年11月30日的ChatGPT公开发布,2025年8月26日的双子2.5闪光影像(Nano Banana)和2026年4月21日的ChatGPT影像2.0(GPT影像2)分别标志着S2,S3和S4的开始[9,10,11]. 前两个阶段在前一天结束。 阶段性任务遵循了抽样视觉版本的公开证据。 这些里程碑表明工具的可用性,没有确定原始作者的使用.

blocks.zh: 图2:跨时间阶段的主要抽样设计、候选源集合和经常性研究课题。 源标签表示搜索范围,发布里程碑表示工具可用性. 时间线长度为示意图.

blocks.en: For S1–S3, discovery began with CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV main-conference directories on CVF Open Access and ECVA, supplemented by arXiv version records. Eligibility required an arXiv record and at least one author with more than 10,000 cumulative citations on a verifiable public scholarly profile. Citation snapshots were collected on 21–28 October 2026, after the material cutoff. This criterion reflects author visibility at retrieval and does not validate paper quality.
blocks.zh: 对于S1-S3,发现开始于CVPR,ICCV,以及ECCV主会目录关于CVF Open Access和ECVA,辅以arXiv版本记录. 资格要求有一个ArXiv记录和至少一个作者在可核查的公共学术概况中累计引用超过10,000个。 2026年10月21日至28日,即材料截断后,收集了引用快照。 这个标准反映了作者在检索时的能见度,并不验证纸张质量.

blocks.en: For S4, discovery used public ICLR 2027 submissions on OpenReview. The September 2026 submission cycle followed the release of GPT Image 2 [ 12 ] , and the submissions were under review when collected. We initially applied the same arXiv and author-citation requirements. When reviewed candidates satisfying both requirements did not fill a topic quota, either or both requirements were waived. Papers admitted under the original and relaxed criteria remain separately identified.
blocks.zh: 对于S4,发现时使用了公开的ICLR 2027关于OpenReview的提交. 2026年9月的提交周期是GPT图像2[12]发布之后,提交材料在收集时正在审查之中。 我们最初采用了同样的arXiv和作者引用要求。 在符合两项要求的被审查候选人没有填补专题配额时,要么放弃这两项要求。 按照原先和放宽的标准接受的文件仍然单独列出。

blocks.en: 3.2 Collection and Figure Verification
blocks.zh: 3.2 收集和图象核实

blocks.en: Fig. 3 summarizes the two collection paths. Main-sample selection used figure-role and version checks to fill the temporal and topical quotas without considering aesthetic appeal or perceived AI-like style. The contrast sample used title-guided inspection and purposive visual selection without requiring paired M and F figures. The retained paper sets are disjoint, although their candidate pools overlap and their retrieval counts cannot be summed.
blocks.zh: 图3概述了两个收集路径。 主要样本选择使用数字作用和版本检查来填补时间和专题配额,而不考虑审美吸引力或感知的AI风格。 对比样本采用标题指导检查和有目的的视觉选择,不需要配对的M和F数字. 保留下来的成套纸片是脱节的,尽管其候选组合重叠,无法汇总其检索数。

blocks.en: Main-sample searches used topic-specific terms. Detection queries included object detection and object detector , while segmentation queries included semantic segmentation and instance segmentation . Restoration queries covered image restoration , denoising , deblurring , and super-resolution . Queries for 3D vision included 3D reconstruction , multi-view reconstruction , and surface reconstruction . Retrieval snapshots preserve the query scope and pagination. The 11 S4 queries yielded 2,103 distinct candidate records within this search scope and do not constitute a census of the conference. The cumulative S1–S3 retrieval history has not been reconstructed into a deduplicated screening funnel, so aggregate retrieval and exclusion counts are unavailable for those stages.
blocks.zh: 主样本搜索使用了主题特定术语. 探测查询包括物体探测器和物体探测器,而分区查询包括语义分区和实例分区. 恢复问题包括图像恢复、解密、破解和超解。 三维愿景的查询包括三维重建、多景重建以及地面重建。 检索快照会保留查询范围和页码. 11个S4查询在这个查询范围内产生了2 103个不同的候选人记录,不构成会议普查。 累积的S1-S3检索历史没有重建成一个破损的筛选漏斗,因此这些阶段的汇总检索和排除计数都无法得到。

blocks.en: Figure roles were assessed from the complete image, its caption, and relevant body text. An M figure introduces a problem through limitations, failure cases, conceptual contrasts, or application needs. An F figure depicts an overall architecture, major module relationships, or a principal training or inference workflow. Performance-only charts, ordinary result montages, and isolated module diagrams do not qualify solely because they contain relevant visual elements. When several figures qualified, we prioritized the first problem-introducing figure for M and the explicitly designated overall framework for F. Remaining ties were resolved by figure number.
blocks.zh: 从完整的图像、其标题和相关的正文中评估了图表的作用。 M数字通过限制、失败案例、概念对比或应用需求提出了问题。 一个F图描绘了总体架构,主要模块关系,或主要的培训或推论工作流程. 仅表现图,普通结果调图,以及孤立的模块图单因包含相关的视觉元素而不能合格. 当几个数字符合条件时,我们优先列出M的第一个问题介绍数字和F的明确指定的总体框架。 其余的联系由数字解决。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Two collection paths produce 200 papers and 371 figures. A: Role and version checks support quota-based selection of paired motivation (M) and framework (F) figures. B: Purposive selection retains eligible M and/or F figures. Candidate pools overlap. In the contrast pool, 47 PDFs underwent visual inspection.
blocks.zh: 图3:两条收集途径产生了200篇论文和371份数字。 A:作用和版本检查支持基于配额的对配动力(M)和框架(F)数字的选择。 B: 选择性选择保留合格的M和/或F数字。 候选人人才库重叠。 在对比池中,47个PDF进行了目视检查。

blocks.en: For each main-sample figure, we sought the earliest verifiable public occurrence of the sampled visual version. Composition, elements, colors, and connections were compared across available versions, with posting and submission records establishing dates or date ranges. Changes to surrounding text or experiments do not alter the visual-version date when the sampled figure remains unchanged. A later redraw is dated from its own verifiable public appearance. Both M and F figures must qualify for the paper’s assigned stage, and an earlier arXiv figure may therefore be retained instead of a later conference version. A figure was not assigned to a stage when a possible earlier-stage occurrence remained unresolved. These records establish public availability rather than creation dates. Historical tracing is more limited for S4 papers without matched arXiv records, and the manifest preserves the available date precision.
blocks.zh: 对于每个主样本图, 我们寻求 最早可核实的公开发生 抽样的视觉版本。 对现有版本的构成、要素、颜色和连接进行了比较,张贴和提交记录确定了日期或日期范围。 对周边文字或实验的修改,不会改变被抽样数字保持不变时的视觉版日期. 后来的重划是源于其自身可核查的公开外观. M和F数字都必须符合论文指定阶段的条件,因此可以保留较早的arXiv数字,而不是以后的会议版本。 在可能发生的较早阶段仍未解决的情况下,没有给出数字。 这些记录确定了公开日期,而不是创建日期。 对没有匹配arXiv记录的S4文件来说,历史追查较为有限,而且清单保留了现有的日期精确性。

blocks.en: The contrast path searched additional ICLR 2027 submissions without topic quotas, arXiv matching, or author-citation requirements. The four queries were multi-agent , agentic , multimodal , and benchmark . They returned 11,157 distinct records, and merging these results with existing candidates yielded a pool of 12,926 records. Title relevance guided inspection of 47 PDFs, of which 40 were retained and seven were not. Selected figures prominently combined conventions such as nested boxes, labeled panels, explanatory text, icons, and pastel colors. Selection required neither a numerical threshold nor the presence of every feature. Candidates that were not inspected are not counted as exclusions following full-text assessment.
blocks.zh: 对比路径搜索了额外的ICLR 2027文件,没有主题配额,arXiv匹配,或作者引用要求. 四个查询是多代理、代理、多式联运和基准。 他们归还了11 157份不同的记录,并将这些结果与现有候选人合并,产生了12 926份记录。 标题相关指导检查47个PDF,其中保留40个,没有保留7个。 选定的数字突出地结合了各种惯例,如嵌套箱、贴有标签的面板、解释性文字、图标和面板颜色。 选择既不需要数字阈值,也不需要每个特性的存在。 未经检查的候选人经全文评估后不算作被排除在外。

blocks.en: Eleven contrast papers contribute both M and F figures, and 29 contribute F figures only. The legacy label S4-AI-Style identifies this collection path. It does not establish AI authorship or an earliest visual occurrence within S4. Fixed submission PDFs and public-date evidence are archived, but earliest matching visual versions were not systematically traced across arXiv and project histories. The contrast sample is therefore analyzed separately from temporal stage means and cannot estimate the prevalence of its selected conventions.
blocks.zh: 11份对比文件提供了M和F两个数字,29份仅提供了F数字。 遗留标签S4-AI-Style识别了此收藏路径. 它没有确定AI的作者身份或S4中最早的视觉事件. 固定提交的PDF和公开日期证据已存档,但没有系统地在ArXiv和项目历史中追溯到最早匹配的视觉版本。 因此,将对比样本与时间阶段的含义分开分析,无法估计其选定的公约的普遍性。

blocks.en: Complete figure regions were cropped from fixed PDFs, retaining all panels, labels, legends, arrows, and symbols. The cropped PDF assets preserve the original PDF objects, including embedded raster content. PNG versions were rendered at 300 dpi with the original aspect ratio, without redrawing, recoloring, text replacement, or generative enhancement. Each export was visually inspected and linked to its caption, source page, crop coordinates, URL, version evidence, and file hash. Anonymous evaluation copies omit external source labels while retaining content within the figure. Drawing-tool disclosures are recorded separately, and production provenance remains unknown in the absence of direct evidence.
blocks.zh: 完整的图区域从固定的PDF中裁剪,保留所有面板、标签、传说、箭头和符号。 所裁剪的PDF资产保存了PDF原始对象,包括嵌入式光栅内容. PNG版本以300 dpi的原宽比提供,不重绘,重彩,文本替换,或基因增强. 每次导出都经过目视检查,并与标题、源页、作物坐标、URL、版本证据和文件散列链接。 匿名评价副本在保留图中内容的同时省略了外部来源标签. 绘图工具的披露是单独记录的,在没有直接证据的情况下,生产来源仍然不明。

blocks.en: The archive preserves paper and figure manifests, exclusions, retrieval logs, fixed sources, and blind-ID mappings. The accompanying methods project provides aggregate plotting data, source-file hashes, editable vector figures, and figure-generation code. Corpus counts derive from the main-sample manifests of 160 papers and 320 figures and the contrast-sample manifests of 40 papers and 51 figures. Collection, role assessment, version comparison, and cropping used OpenAI’s gpt-6-astra under researcher-specified rules, in sessions separate from quality assessment. Independent expert verification and inter-rater reliability were not established.
blocks.zh: 档案保存了纸张和图象的显示、排除、检索日志、固定来源和盲ID映射。 配套方法项目提供汇总绘图数据,源文件散列,可编辑矢量数字,以及图生成代码. Corpus计数来源于160份论文和320位数字的主要样本清单以及40份论文和51位数字的对比样本清单。 收集、角色评估、版本比较和裁剪在与质量评估分开的会议中使用了OpenAI规定的Gpt-6-astra。 独立专家的核查和反应方之间的可靠性没有确定。

blocks.en: 3.3 Corpus Characteristics and Comparison Scope
blocks.zh: 3.3 公司特征和比较范围

blocks.en: Fig. 4 summarizes the realized corpus and the differences that remain despite balanced quotas. Each main-sample stage contains 40 papers and 80 figures, but S4 includes two eligibility tiers (panel A). Its 17 original-criteria papers comprise nine restoration papers and eight 3D papers. The 23 relaxed-criteria papers comprise all 10 detection papers, all 10 segmentation papers, one restoration paper, and two 3D papers.
blocks.zh: 图4总结了尽管配额平衡但已实现的本体和仍然存在的差别。 每个主样本阶段包含40篇论文和80位数字,但S4包含两个资格等级(A组). 其17份原标准文件包括9份修复文件和8份三维文件。 23份放宽标准文件包括所有10份检测文件、所有10份分区文件、一份修复文件以及两份3D文件。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Corpus composition. A: Main-sample allocation and S4 eligibility tiers. B: Fixed PDF sources, distinct from publication venues. C: OpenReview submission areas of the contrast sample, with shortened metadata labels. D: Motivation (M) and framework (F) figure counts. The contrast sample is excluded from temporal stage averages.
blocks.zh: 图4:公司构成。 A:主要抽样分配和S4资格等级。 B:固定PDF来源,有别于出版场所. C:对比样本的 OpenReview 提交区域,元数据标签缩短. D:动机(M)和框架(F)图数。 对比样本被排除在时间阶段平均值之外。

blocks.en: Source composition also varies across stages (panel B). At the paper level, 39, 38, and 32 papers in S1, S2, and S3, respectively, use conference PDFs as their fixed figure sources. The corresponding arXiv-source counts are one, two, and eight, yielding 109 conference-source papers and 11 arXiv-source papers overall. The retained conference labels are CVPR and ECCV. No ICCV paper was retained despite its inclusion in the search scope. Three papers with arXiv figure sources also have a CVPR venue label, demonstrating that the fixed source version does not determine publication status. All S4 figure sources are fixed ICLR 2027 submission PDFs.
blocks.zh: 各个阶段(B组)的来源构成也各不相同。 在纸张方面,S1、S2和S3的39、38和32份文件分别使用会议PDF作为其固定数字来源。 相应的arXiv来源计数为一,二,八,共产生109份会议来源论文和11份arXiv来源论文. 保留的会议标签为CVPR和ECCV. 尽管列入搜索范围,但没有保留任何《国际犯罪分类》文件。 有arXiv图源的三篇论文也有一个CVPR会场标签,表明固定源版本不能决定出版状况. 所有S4数字来源都是固定的ICLR 2027提交PDF.

blocks.en: The contrast sample is concentrated in two OpenReview primary_area categories (panel C). Modality applications and datasets and benchmarks each contribute 13 papers, with the remaining 14 papers distributed across nine other areas. These metadata categories differ from the four task families used in the main sample. Panel D reports 160 M and 160 F figures in the main sample and 11 M and 40 F figures in the contrast sample, yielding 171 M and 200 F figures overall.
blocks.zh: 对比样本集中在两个OpenReview prime_area类别(C组). 模式应用以及数据集和基准各提供了13份文件,其余14份文件分发到其他9个领域。 这些元数据类别与主要抽样中使用的四个任务类别不同。 小组D报告主要样本中160 M和160 F数字,对比样本中11 M和40 F数字,总体为171 M和200 F数字。

blocks.en: Temporal coverage is also uneven (Table 1 ). Stage windows differ in duration, and sampling was not balanced by year. In S1, 52 of the 80 figures date to 2022, and none date to 2016 or 2017. The start of the eligibility window therefore precedes the earliest retained figure versions.
blocks.zh: 时间覆盖率也参差不齐(表1)。 阶段窗口持续时间不同,采样过程没有逐年平衡. 在S1中,80个数字中的52个数字到2022年,没有一个数字到2016年或2017年. 因此,资格窗口的开始要先于最早的保留数字版本。

blocks.en: Table 1: Temporal distribution of verified figure versions in the main sample. Entries count figures, and dashes denote zero.
blocks.zh: 表1:主要样本中经核实的数字版本的时间分布。 条目数数字,破折号表示0。

blocks.en: These characteristics delimit the comparisons supported by the corpus. Neither collection path produces a probability sample. Equal quotas do not equalize source populations, eligibility conditions, review status, or the distribution of years within each stage. The contrast sample additionally reflects purposive selection by appearance and a different topical scope. Temporal differences therefore cannot isolate the effects of AI assistance, and figures drawn from the same paper must be treated as clustered observations.
blocks.zh: 这些特征界定了本文书所支持的比较。 无论是收集路径都无法生成概率样本 。 平等配额并不能使来源人口、资格条件、审查状况或每一阶段的年数分布均等。 对比抽样还进一步反映了按外观和不同主题范围有目的的选择。 因此,时间差异不能孤立人工智能援助的效果,从同一份文件中得出的数字必须作为集群观察处理。

blocks.en: 4 Multimodal Evaluation and Source-Constrained Revision
blocks.zh: 4 多式联运评价和来源限制修订

blocks.en: Scientific figure revision seeks to improve visual communication while preserving scientific meaning. Our protocol evaluates these objectives separately through anonymous image-based quality assessment and source-informed fidelity review. Revisions that pass fidelity review are compared with their originals using the same quality criteria.
blocks.zh: 科学人物修正寻求在保持科学意义的同时改善视觉交流. 我们的协议通过匿名图像质量评估和来源知情的忠诚审查分别评估这些目标。 通过忠诚审查的修订采用同样的质量标准与原件进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 Assessment Criteria
blocks.zh: 4.1 评估标准

blocks.en: The six dimensions in Table 2 assess the accessibility of an explanation, the coherence of its visual organization, and the specificity and inventiveness of its expression. Scores range from 1 to 5, with explicit anchors at 1, 3, and 5 and intermediate scores of 2 and 4. The definitions and anchors remain fixed across original and revised figures. These study-defined criteria operationalize the design concerns introduced in Section 2 and do not constitute a validated psychometric instrument. Because each dimension uses distinct criteria, differences between their means describe a rubric profile rather than calibrated differences on a common quality scale.
blocks.zh: 表2的六个方面评估了解释的可获取性、其视觉组织的一致性以及其表达的特异性和创造性。 得分从1到5,明确主播为1,3和5,中间得分为2和4. 定义和锚点仍然固定在原始和订正数字之间。 这些由研究确定的标准将第2节提出的设计考虑付诸实施,不构成有效的心理计量仪器。 由于每个维度都使用不同的标准,因此其手段之间的差异描述的是一个面额剖面图,而不是在共同的质量尺度上校准的差异.

blocks.en: Table 2: Operational dimensions and compact scoring anchors. Scores of 2 and 4 indicate performance between adjacent anchors. The same frozen rubric is used for original and revised figures.
blocks.zh: 表2:业务层面和紧凑的积分锚。 得分2和4表示相邻锚之间的性能. 原始数字和订正数字使用相同的冻结数字。

blocks.en: The rubric evaluates visual devices by their explanatory function. Conventional boxes may receive high scores, while illustrations, icons, gradients, and hand-drawn marks receive no automatic preference. Framework overviews are assessed at their intended level of abstraction. The judge is instructed to avoid inferences about authorship, effort, historical period, software, or paper reputation. Because external captions and manuscript text are withheld, clarity and specificity concern the information conveyed by the supplied figure. Correspondence with source evidence is assessed separately during fidelity review.
blocks.zh: 标题通过视觉设备的解释功能来评价. 常规框可能获得很高的分数,而插图,图标,梯度,手绘标记则不会获得自动偏好. 框架概览按预期抽象程度评估。 法官奉命避免对作者身份,努力,历史时期,软件,或纸面声誉进行推论. 由于外部标题和手稿文本被扣,清晰和具体涉及所提供的数字所传递的信息。 与来源证据的信件往来在忠诚审查期间分别评估。

blocks.en: Responses follow a structured JSON format. For each dimension, the judge provides an integer score or a null value, a concrete visual observation, and an assessment limitation. A null value requires an explicit reason. Image-level fields record readability and general limitations. Retaining this evidence alongside the scores makes the basis of each judgment available for inspection.
blocks.zh: 答复采用结构化的JSON格式。 对于每个维度,法官提供整数分数或无效值,具体的视觉观察,以及评估限制. 无效价值需要明确的理由。 图像级字段记录可读性和一般限制. 在计分的同时保留这种证据,是每项判决的依据,可供检查。

blocks.en: 4.2 Anonymous Repeated Judgments
blocks.zh: 4.2 匿名重复判决

blocks.en: Each request contains the frozen rubric, the figure’s motivation (M) or framework (F) role, and three image views. These comprise the complete anonymized figure and two deterministic crops along its longer axis. The crops jointly cover the figure with a 10% overlap, with boundaries rounded outward to integer pixels. Local preparation preserves the pixels of the prepared rating image without resizing or enhancement. External captions, paper titles, author identities, venues, years, stage and sample labels, and previous ratings are withheld. Text and imagery within the figure remain intact, so familiar figures may still be recognizable. Any additional image processing within the model service is unobserved.
blocks.zh: 每个请求都包含被冻结的标题,人物的动机(M)或框架(F)角色,以及三个图像视图. 其中包括完整的无名数字和沿较长轴线的两种确定性作物。 作物以10%的重叠率共同覆盖这个数字,边界向外四舍五入到整数像素。 本地制备保存了已准备的评级图像的像素,而不调整大小或增强. 外部标题,纸张标题,作者身份,地点,年限,舞台和样本标签,以及先前的评分被扣. 数字中的文字和图像保持不变,因此熟悉的数字仍然可以辨认。 模型服务中的任何额外图像处理都是不可观察的.

blocks.en: Each original figure receives three repeated judgments, yielding 1,113 validated responses for 371 figures. Failed requests are archived and retried within the same slot defined by figure and repetition. Only one validated response per slot enters the analysis. Visual observations are preserved in the judge’s original English wording. A procedural pilot used eight figures spanning all combinations of stage and role and collectively covering the four main topics. The pilot assessed instruction compliance and the grounding of explanations in visible evidence. Its responses are excluded from the primary analysis.
blocks.zh: 每个原始数字都收到三次重复判决,就371个数字作出了1 113项经核实的答复。 失败的请求在图和重复定义的相同槽内存档和重试. 每个槽只有一个经过验证的答复进入分析。 法官的英文原文保留了视觉观察。 一个程序试点使用了8个数字,涉及舞台和角色的所有组合,并集体涵盖4个主要专题。 试点评估了遵守指令的情况和以明显证据解释的依据。 其答复被排除在主要分析之外。

blocks.en: All reported quality judgments were obtained using OpenAI’s gpt-6-astra through Codex (version 0.163.0-alpha.10.2 ). Original figures were evaluated on 31 October 2026, and revision evaluation continued through 1 November 2026. Each repetition used a fresh ephemeral request with external retrieval, persistent memory, shell and multi-agent tools, apps, plugins, project-document loading, and host-skill discovery disabled. These controls standardize the supplied context but do not remove implicit service instructions. Because a hosted model can change behind a fixed identifier, timestamps, requested settings, request metadata, and raw responses are archived. All reported quality ratings come from this configuration. The same model was also used, in separate sessions, for corpus construction, revision briefs, and fidelity review (Sections 3.2 and 4.3 ). Across the entire project, the workflow consumed an estimated one billion tokens. Cross-model agreement, counterbalanced pairwise preferences, and agreement with human assessments were not evaluated.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的质量判决都是通过OpenAI的gpt-6-astra通过Codex(0.163.0-alpha.10.2版)获得的。 2026年10月31日对原始数字进行了评价,修订评价一直持续到2026年11月1日. 每次重复都使用新鲜的麻黄请求,外部检索、持续内存、 shell 和多代理工具、应用软件、插件、项目文件加载和主机技能发现被禁用。 这些控制使所提供的上下文标准化,但并不删除隐含的服务指令. 因为一个主机模型可以在固定标识符后改变,时间戳,请求设置,请求元数据,原始回复被存档. 所有报告的质量评级都来自这一配置。 在不同的会议中,也采用了同样的模式来进行人身保护、修订案情摘要和忠诚审查(第3.2和4.3节)。 在整个项目中,工作流程消耗了大约10亿令牌。 未评价跨模式协议、对等对等偏好和与人类评估的协议。

blocks.en: 4.3 Source-Constrained Revision and Fidelity Review
blocks.zh: 4.3 受来源限制的修订和 " Fieldity " 审查

blocks.en: We attempted a revision of every original figure. Each brief combined the source image, its caption and relevant manuscript explanation, and limitations identified in the original ratings. Briefs were prepared and revisions directed by gpt-6-astra in sessions separate from quality assessment. The revision process therefore had access to source information withheld during quality assessment. It also incorporated feedback from the same model used for subsequent scoring, although revised figures were scored in fresh sessions without access to the briefs or the original ratings. Paired changes characterize this feedback-guided workflow under the configured evaluator.
blocks.zh: 我们试图修改每一个原始数字。 每份简报都结合了源图像,其标题和相关手稿解释,以及原始收视率确定的局限性. 由gpt-6-astra在与质量评估分开的会议中编写简报和修订。 因此,修订过程可以获取质量评估期间未披露的来源信息。 它还吸收了对以后评分所采用的同一模式的反馈,尽管在新课上对订正数字进行了评分,但没有获得简报或原始评分。 在配置的评价人员下,这种反馈指导工作流程被描述为 " 变迁 " 。

blocks.en: The workflow combined OpenAI’s gpt-image-2.5 for image generation, with programmatic restoration of source content where necessary. Photographs, masks, heatmaps, curves, numerical values, and other protected data-bearing regions were retained from the source. The archive records source regions, their placements, and applicable pixel-preservation checks. Revisions range from reorganized diagrams to retained scientific panels supplemented with reading guides or explanatory keys. Observed changes can therefore reflect both altered presentation and additional information made explicit within the image. The intervention does not isolate the contributions of layout, color, or generative rendering.
blocks.zh: 工作流程将OpenAI的gpt-image-2.5用于图像生成,必要时对源内容进行程序恢复. 照片、口罩、热图、曲线、数值和其他有数据保护的区域均保留来源。 档案记录了源区域、其位置以及适用的像素保存检查。 修订范围从重新编排的图表到保留的科学小组,并附有阅读指南或解释性钥匙。 因此,观察到的变化既可以反映改变的列报方式,也可以反映图像中明确显示的更多信息。 干预并不孤立布局、颜色或基因渲染的贡献。

blocks.en: Fidelity review used gpt-6-astra in sessions separate from quality assessment to compare each derivative with the source figure and available caption and body text. The review examined objects, relationships, labels, and scope alongside applicable pixel-restoration checks. Passing indicates that the recorded checks found no disqualifying discrepancy and does not constitute independent expert validation. Of 371 attempted revisions, 369 passed and received three fresh anonymous quality judgments each, yielding 1,107 final-version responses. Two figures remained unsuccessful after an initial draft and two semantic repairs. The EAGLE motivation figure incorrectly connected image inputs to authenticity instructions. The Make It Up framework omitted a pooling-to-local-prototype update and introduced an unsupported reverse connection. Both remain in the revision-attempt denominator without revision quality scores. Paired quality analysis is therefore conditional on passing fidelity review.
blocks.zh: Fidelity Review在与质量评估分开的会话中使用gpt-6-astra来比较每个衍生词与源图以及可用的标题和正文. 审查审查了对象、关系、标签和范围以及适用的像素恢复检查。 通过表明,记录的支票没有发现不符合资格,不构成独立专家的鉴定。 在试图订正的371项判决中,369项通过并收到3项新的匿名质量判决,结果有1 107项最后版本答复。 经过初步起草和两次语义修复,两个数字仍未成功。 EAGLE动机图将图像输入错误地连接到真实性指示. Make Up框架省略了集合到本地原型的更新,引入了不支持的反向连接. 两者都留在修订测试分母中,没有修订质量分数。 因此,Paired质量分析以通过忠诚审查为条件。

blocks.en: Semantic repairs do not constitute additional intervention samples, and accepted revisions were not regenerated in response to low quality scores. An earlier scored PhoenixSR revision was superseded after further verification. Its three responses are retained as historical records and excluded from the final analysis. Checksums link images, anonymous views, prompts, responses, and accepted derivatives to ensure that scores correspond to the final image version. Original rating records remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 语义修补不构成额外的干预样本,被接受的修改没有因质量分数低而重新生成. 在进一步核实之后,先前的 " 凤凰社 " 订正版本被取代。 它的三个答复被保留作为历史记录,并被排除在最后分析之外。 校验和会链接图像,匿名视图,提示,回复,以及被接受的衍生工具,以确保分数与最终图像版本相符. 原始评级记录保持不变。

blocks.en: Uncertainty in reported mean changes is summarized using 95% paper-cluster bootstrap percentile intervals with 5,000 resamples and random seed 20261020. Paper identifiers are sampled uniformly with replacement within the relevant analysis set. Each sampled paper contributes all its included figures and their matched versions, and each replicate recomputes the figure-weighted mean. The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles define the interval. This procedure preserves within-paper dependence and the original figure weighting, using frozen score files linked to paper identities through the manifest. Neither the 2,220 validated responses nor the 2,214 paired figure–dimension outcomes are treated as independent sampling units. The intervals quantify resampling variability within the corpus. They do not account for non-probability selection, source and eligibility differences, service drift, or systematic evaluator bias.

blocks.en: 5.1 Original Profiles and Temporal Context
blocks.zh: 5.1 原始概况和时间背景

blocks.en: Orderly presentation, distinctive content, and explanatory clarity do not necessarily coincide (Fig. 5 ). Across all four stages, main-sample motivation figures have higher mean organization ratings than clarity ratings. The numerical difference narrows from 0.875 in S1 to 0.550 in S4, as clarity increases by 0.550 and organization by 0.225. The kernel-reformulation example illustrates the underlying design distinction. Its aligned image panels provide an orderly comparison, but the significance of that comparison remains insufficiently stated [ 17 ] . Organizing examples and explaining their relevance are separate compositional decisions.
blocks.zh: 编排有序、内容独特和解释性明确不一定一致(图5)。 在所有四个阶段中,主要抽样动机人物的组织平均评级高于清晰评级。 数字差异从S1的0.875缩小到S4的0.550,因为清晰度增加了0.550,组织度增加了0.225. 内核重组的例子说明了基本的设计区别. 其一致的图像面板提供了有序的比较,但这种比较的重要性仍未得到充分阐述[17]。 组织实例和解释其相关性是不同的组成决定。

blocks.en: Framework figures receive their highest mean ratings for specificity in every stage. From S1 to S4, specificity increases from 4.400 to 4.800, while clarity changes from 3.625 to 3.725 and consistency decreases from 4.000 to 3.725. High specificity therefore does not imply equally favorable ratings for the explanation of relationships or the consistency of visual encodings. Both roles have their lowest mean aesthetic scores in S3 (3.425 for each) and their highest in S4 (3.825 for motivation figures and 3.600 for frameworks). S4 motivation figures also have the highest mean clarity and organization scores, whereas S4 frameworks have the lowest mean consistency score. The profiles consequently reveal changes that differ by dimension and figure role, rather than a uniform historical decline.
blocks.zh: 框架数字在每个阶段的特异性都得到最高平均评级。 从S1到S4,特异性从4.400增加到4.800,而清晰度从3.625改为3.725,一致性从4.000减少到3.725. 因此,高度具体并不意味着对关系的解释或视觉编码的一致性给予同等有利的评级。 这两个角色的平均审美分最低的是S3(每个角色3.425),最高的是S4(动机数字3.825,框架3.600). S4激励数字的平均清晰度和组织分数也最高,而S4框架的平均一致性分数最低。 因此,概况显示的变化因层面和数字作用而异,而不是一个统一的历史衰落。

blocks.en: Purposeful visual inventiveness also remains distinct from technical specificity and visual polish. Mean inventiveness scores across the main-sample stage and role groups range from 3.275 to 3.550. Across all original figures, 58 receive a specificity median of 5 but an inventiveness median no greater than 3. Another 68 receive an aesthetic median of at least 4 but a clarity median no greater than 3. These exploratory combinations illustrate why a favorable score in one dimension cannot substitute for examining the complete profile.
blocks.zh: 目的性的视觉发明性也仍然有别于技术特性和视觉光泽. 主要抽样阶段和角色组的平均发明分数从3.275到3.550不等。 在所有原始数字中,58个的特异性中位数为5,但发明性中位数不超过3。 另外68人得到的美学中位数至少为4,但清晰度中位数不超过3. 这些探索性组合说明了为什么一个维度的有利分数不能取代对完整剖面的检查。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Original-figure profiles across stages and roles. Cells show means of per-figure medians from three judgments, and panel labels report figure counts. The main sample retains equal topic quotas, and the purposive contrast sample is displayed separately. All panels share the same 1–5 color scale.
blocks.zh: 图5:不同阶段和不同角色的原始图表简介。 单元格显示来自三个判断的每图中位数的手段,面板标签报告数字计数. 主要样本保留同等话题配额,目的对比样本单独显示. 所有面板都使用相同的1–5色尺度.

blocks.en: The gallery provides examples of expanding explanatory scope. Within image restoration, the S1 framework in entry 030 organizes two training components around pseudo-pair generation and transfer between source and target domains [ 18 ] . In S2, Complexity Experts combines an overall architecture, transformer blocks, and nested expert routing [ 25 ] . In S3, UARE coordinates instructions, images, two expert pathways, training stages, and multimodal outputs [ 34 ] . The S4 framework in entry 147 extends the account to prediction, action selection, execution, verification, and tool evolution [ 42 ] . Across these selected examples, a single composition accommodates progressively more levels of explanation.
blocks.zh: 展馆提供了扩大解释范围的例子。 在图像恢复方面,第030项中的S1框架围绕伪pair生成和源域与目标域之间的转移组织两个培训组件[18]. 在S2中,复杂化专家结合了整体建筑,变压器块,以及嵌入式专家路线[25]. 在S3中,UARE协调指示、图像、两个专家路径、培训阶段和多式联运产出[34]。 第147项中的S4框架将账户扩展至预测、动作选择、执行、核查和工具演变[42]。 在这些选定的例子中,一个单一的构成逐渐包含更多的解释。

blocks.en: Increasing technical scope can create a need to depict additional interacting functions. AI assistance may also make panels, icons, and annotations easier to produce, potentially encouraging elaboration. The present collection cannot separate these explanations or establish a monotonic historical trend in visual complexity. Early entry 030 already uses gradients, rounded panels, and shadows, while the later E-RayZer framework retains a clear horizontal reading path [ 35 ] . These examples direct attention to whether each visual layer expresses a necessary relationship and remains integrated with the overall explanation.
blocks.zh: 技术范围的扩大可导致需要描绘更多的相互作用功能。 大赦国际的协助还可能使小组、图标和说明更容易制作,可能令人感到鼓舞。 本集不能将这些解释分开,也不能确立视觉复杂性的单调历史趋势. 早期条目030已经使用梯度,圆形面板,以及阴影,而后来的E-RayZer框架保留了明确的水平读取路径[35]. 这些例子引导人们注意每个视觉层是否表达了必要的关系,并且仍然与总体解释相结合.

blocks.en: 5.2 Visual Conventions in the Style-Contrast Sample
blocks.zh: 5.2 样式组合样本中的视觉常规

blocks.en: The purposive style-contrast sample contains 40 papers and 51 figures. Its atlas label, S4-AI-Style , identifies a selection path and does not establish AI production or define a fifth temporal stage. The 11 motivation figures reverse the ordering observed in the main sample, with mean clarity exceeding mean organization. Relative to S4 main-sample motivation figures, they receive higher clarity and inventiveness ratings but lower organization and aesthetic ratings. The 40 contrast frameworks exceed their S4 counterparts in aesthetics and consistency while retaining high specificity (4.650). The selected conventions therefore accompany different rating profiles across the two roles.
blocks.zh: 目的性风格-相容性样本包含40篇论文和51位数字. 它的地图集标签S4-AI-Style(英语:S4-AI-Style)确定了选择路径,没有建立AI生产或定义第五时段. 11个动机数字颠倒了在主要样本中观察到的顺序,平均清晰度超过了平均组织. 相对于S4主样本动机人物,他们获得更高的清晰度和发明性评级,但组织和美学评级较低. 40个对比框架在美学和一致性方面超过了S4框架,同时保持高度特殊性(4.650)。 因此,所选定的公约与两个角色的不同评级说明相配合。

blocks.en: Their explanatory potential is visible in individual compositions. Agent Skills Under Change uses recurring robots, folders, targets, and shields to compare immediate updates with checks of adaptation and retention. Its clarity, organization, and consistency medians are all 5 [ 46 ] . Sprout connects queries and operations through timelines and shared memory, receiving inventiveness and specificity medians of 5 for both roles [ 51 ] . AccessWorld, the original framework with the highest six-dimension mean, also belongs to this sample [ 53 ] . These cases illustrate how familiar graphical elements can support distinctive explanations when their relationships carry specific meaning.
blocks.zh: 其解释潜力可见于个人构成。 Agent Swills Under Change使用反复出现的机器人,文件夹,目标和盾牌来比较即时更新和检查适应和保留. 其清晰度、组织和一致性中位数均为5[46]。 Sprout通过时间表和共享内存将查询和操作连接起来,获得两个角色的发明性和特异性中位数为5[51]. AccessWorld,最初的六分法平均值最高的框架,也属于这个样本[53]. 这些案件说明,当其关系具有具体意义时,熟悉的图形要素如何能够支持独特的解释。

blocks.en: The revision workflow nevertheless produces limited aggregate gains for contrast frameworks. Their six-dimension mean increases in five figures, remains unchanged in 16, and decreases in 19. Mean aesthetics, organization, and inventiveness decrease by 0.300, 0.175, and 0.100, respectively. Specificity remains unchanged in 37 figures and decreases in three. OpenAgentFlow illustrates the role difference within one paper. Its motivation mean increases from 3.83 to 4.50, while its framework mean decreases from 3.50 to 3.17 following a revision that adds an outcome key beneath an already dense workflow [ 50 ] . Such cases suggest that selective emphasis and consolidation deserve consideration when a composition already contains extensive explanatory material.
blocks.zh: 然而,修订工作流程对对比框架的总体收益有限。 他们的六分法意味着增加五个数字,16个数字保持不变,19个数字减少。 平均美学、组织和发明分别减少0.300、0.175和0.100。 具体程度在37个数字中保持不变,在3个数字中有所下降。 OpenAgentFlow在一张纸中说明了角色差异. 其动机意味着从3.83增加到4.50,而其框架意味着在修订之后从3.50减少到3.17,修订后在已经密集的工作流程下增加了一个结果关键[50]。 这些情况表明,如果某一构成已经包含大量解释性材料,就应当考虑有选择地强调和合并。

blocks.en: 5.3 Revision Outcomes across Dimensions and Figure Roles
blocks.zh: 5.3 不同层面和图示作用的修订结果

blocks.en: The largest rating gains occur in clarity, while changes in other dimensions are more mixed. Of 371 attempted revisions, 369 pass the recorded fidelity checks, and the two failures remain unscored. The accepted pairs span all 200 papers. Table 3 and Fig. 6 show a mean clarity increase of 0.428, accompanied by smaller increases in specificity and consistency. Mean aesthetics decreases by 0.111, while inventiveness remains unchanged in 317 figures (85.9%). Across 2,214 paired dimension outcomes, 401 increase (18.1%), 1,607 remain unchanged (72.6%), and 206 decrease (9.3%). Most changed medians move by one point, comprising 370 increases and 205 decreases. The six-dimension mean rises from 3.842 to 3.945 ( + 0.103 +0.103 ), combining these opposing movements.
blocks.zh: 最大的评级收益出现在清晰度上,而其他层面的变化则更为复杂。 在371次修改尝试中,369次通过了记录的忠诚检查,两次失败仍未记分。 被接受的对子横跨所有200份论文. 表3和图6显示,平均清晰度增加了0.428,而具体性和一致性的提高则较小。 平均美学减少0.111,而发明性在317个数字中保持不变(85.9%)。 在2 214个配对层面的结果中,401个(18.1%),1 607个(72.6%)保持不变,206个(9.3%)。 大多数变化的中位数移动1点,其中370个增加,205个减少。 六分法指由3.842升至3.945(+0.103+0.103),结合这些对立运动.

blocks.en: The pooled gain differs substantially by figure role (Table 4 ). The six-dimension average increases by 0.242 for main-sample motivation figures and by 0.018 for frameworks. Motivation clarity and specificity increase by 0.800 and 0.306, compared with 0.151 and 0.082 for frameworks. Framework aesthetics decreases by 0.164. The contrast sample similarly combines a small motivation gain with a framework decline. Under this workflow, motivation figures therefore receive more favorable average rating changes than frameworks.
blocks.zh: 集合收益因数字作用而大不相同(表4)。 主要抽样动机数字的六分法平均数增加了0.242,框架增加了0.018。 动机清晰度和特异性增加了0.800和0.306,而框架则增加了0.151和0.082。 框架美学减少0.164. 对比样本同样结合了小的动机增益和框架衰减. 因此,在这一工作流程下,动机数字比框架得到更有利的平均评级变化。

blocks.en: Table 4: Paired six-dimension averages by sample and figure role. M and F denote motivation and framework figures, and n n is the number of accepted original–revision pairs. Intervals are 95% paper-cluster bootstrap percentile intervals within each row. Direction counts refer to changes in the post hoc six-dimension average.
blocks.zh: 表4:按样本和数字角色分列的Paired六位元平均值。 M 和 F 表示动机和框架数字,n 表示被接受的原始修改对数。 间距为每行95%的纸质组靴子间隔。 方向计数是指临时六分配后平均值的变化.

blocks.en: This role difference recurs in every main-sample topic (Table 5 ). Detection motivation figures have the largest mean gain and form the only motivation topic group with a positive mean aesthetic change. Framework aesthetics decreases in all four topics. The distinction also appears within individual papers. Among the 159 papers with accepted revisions for both roles, the motivation change exceeds the framework change in 103, equals it in 23, and falls below it in 33. Of the 31 papers with opposing directions of change, 27 combine a motivation gain with a framework loss, and four show the reverse. Averaging the two roles within a paper would conceal these differences.
blocks.zh: 这种作用差异在每个主要抽样专题中都重复出现(表5)。 检测动机人物拥有最大的平均收益,并组成唯一具有正平均美学变化的动机主题组. 框架美学在所有四个主题中都有所下降. 这种区别也出现在个别文件中。 在159份对两个角色都作了公认修改的文件中,动机变化超过了103个框架变化,等于23个,低于33个。 在31篇有相反变化方向的论文中,27篇将动机增益与框架损益相结合,4篇显示相反. 在一份文件中阐述这两个角色将掩盖这些差异。

blocks.en: Table 5: Main-sample revision changes by topic and figure role, pooling S1–S4. Δ ​ C \Delta C and Δ ​ A \Delta A denote mean changes in clarity and aesthetic coherence, while Δ ​ m ¯ \Delta\bar{m} denotes the change in the post hoc six-dimension average. Counts refer to accepted figure pairs. One segmentation framework failed fidelity review, leaving 39 pairs in that cell and 40 in every other cell.
blocks.zh: 表5:按专题和图作用分列的主要修订变化,汇集S1-S4。 C\Delta C和\A\Delta A表示清晰度和审美一致性的改变,而\M\Delta\bar{m}则表示临时六分法平均值的变化。 计数是指接受的图对. 一个分解框架失败了忠贞性审查,使该细胞中39对,其他每个细胞中40对.

blocks.en: Revision outcomes also vary across stages. Mean motivation clarity increases by 1.075, 0.900, 0.650, and 0.575 in S1–S4, respectively. The six-dimension mean increases for 35 S1 motivation figures, remains unchanged for five, and decreases for none. In S4, the corresponding counts are 14 increases, 14 ties, and 12 decreases. Framework aesthetics decreases in every stage. These patterns place the pooled result in the context of different initial scores and compositions, but stage membership does not identify the mechanisms responsible. Revisions can introduce caption-derived information, alter the canvas, and combine retained panels with explanatory guides. The findings therefore characterize the complete intervention and do not isolate changes in visual style.
blocks.zh: 各个阶段的修订结果也各不相同。 平均动机清晰度在S1-S4中分别增加了1.075,0.900,0.650和0.575. 六分法意味着35个S1动机数字的增加,5个不变,零减少。 在S4中,相应的计数有14个增,14个连,12个减. 框架美学在每个阶段都有所下降. 这些模式将集合结果置于不同的初始分数和组成中,但阶段成员没有确定负责的机制。 修订可以引入字幕衍生信息,改变画布,并将保留面板与解释性指南相结合。 因此,调查结果是完全干预的特点,并不孤立视觉风格的变化。

blocks.en: 5.4 Tradeoffs Concealed by Aggregate Scores
blocks.zh: 5.4 权衡 由总分隐藏

blocks.en: The small overall gain conceals substantial variation among individual figures. Six-dimension means increase for 173 figures (46.9%), remain unchanged for 102 (27.6%), and decrease for 94 (25.5%). Only 79 figures retain all six medians. The 72.6% unchanged rate reported above therefore concerns individual dimension outcomes, not complete figure profiles. Table 6 distinguishes gains without losses, losses without gains, mixed changes, and fully unchanged profiles. Among the 102 figures with unchanged means, 23 have offsetting dimension changes. Another 20 figures show a higher mean despite a decline in at least one dimension. Twenty-one figures gain clarity while losing aesthetic coherence.
blocks.zh: 总体收益很小,掩盖了个人数字之间的巨大差异。 六分配意味着增加173个数字(46.9%),102个数字(27.6%)保持不变,94个数字(25.5%)有所下降。 只有79个数字保留了所有6个中位数。 因此,上文报告的72.6%不变的比率涉及个别层面的结果,而不是完整的数字概况。 表6区分了无损失收益、无收益损失、混合变化和完全不变的情况。 在102个收入不变的数字中,23个有抵消层面的变化。 另有20个数字显示,尽管至少一个维度有所下降,但平均值更高。 21位数字在失去美学一致性的同时获得清晰度.

blocks.en: Table 6: Mutually exclusive patterns of dimension-level change across 369 accepted revisions. A gain or loss denotes an increase or decrease in a figure’s median score on at least one dimension. The unchanged category requires all six medians to remain identical. Percentages use 369 figures as the denominator.
blocks.zh: 表6:在369项已接受的修订中,维度层面变化的相互排斥模式。 损益表示一个数字至少一个维度的中位数增减。 不变的类别要求所有六个中位数保持不变。 百分比使用369个数字作为分母。

blocks.en: PULSE illustrates how opposing changes can leave an average unchanged. Its clarity median increases from 4 to 5 while aesthetics decreases from 5 to 4, leaving the mean at 4.50 [ 38 ] . In the wildfire-reporting framework, added headings and an enlarged interaction detail accompany a consistency increase from 3 to 4 and an aesthetic decrease from 4 to 3 [ 45 ] . Its mean also remains unchanged. In both cases, the stable aggregate conceals a changed evaluation profile.
blocks.zh: PULSE说明了对立的变化如何使平均值保持不变. 其清晰度中位数从4增加到5,而美学从5减少到4,使得平均值为4.50[38]. 在野火报告框架中,随着一致性从3项增加到4项,加上了标题和扩大的相互作用细节,美学从4项减少到3项[45]。 其平均值也保持不变。 在这两种情况下,稳定的总量都掩盖了评价概况的变化。

blocks.en: Initial scores also constrain the available range of change. Specificity reaches the maximum of 5 in 201 of the 371 originals, whereas inventiveness reaches 5 in only three. Within the 369 matched pairs, the number of specificity maxima increases from 199 to 239 and the number of clarity maxima from 16 to 66. Aesthetic maxima decrease from 13 to three. Among matched pairs, originals with means in [ 3 , 4 ) [3,4) gain 0.209 on average ( n = 212 n=212 ), while those starting at 4 or above change by − 0.050 -0.050 ( n = 156 n=156 ). Entry 128 M is the sole original with a mean below 3. The bounded scale constrains improvement at high starting scores, while regression toward the mean and feedback-informed revision may also contribute to this association. Their contributions were not separately estimated. These observations favor identifying the dimensions that require attention before adopting a higher aggregate score as the design objective.
blocks.zh: 最初的得分也限制了现有的变化范围. 特性在371种原件中达到201种最多5种,而发明性只有3种最多5种. 在369对配对中,特异性最大数量从199人增加到239人,清晰度最大数量从16人增加到66人。 美学最大值从13降至3。 在配对的配对中,带有[3,4][3,4] [3,4] 手段的原件平均获得0.209(n=212n=212),而从4或以上开始的原件则以−0.050-0.050(n=156n=156)变化。 第128 M项是唯一一份原件,平均值低于3。 限定的比额表限制了高起点分数的改善,而向平均和反馈知情的修订的倒退也可能促进这种联系。 它们的捐款没有单独估计。 这些意见有利于在采用更高的总分作为设计目标之前确定需要注意的维度。

blocks.en: 5.5 Case Studies: Explanation and Compositional Judgment
blocks.zh: 5.5 案例研究:解释和组成判决

blocks.en: A revision can make a claim more explicit without improving the composition through which it is read. The following cases connect this distinction to visible changes in individual figures. Table 7 identifies absolute score extrema using the post hoc six-dimension mean. Subsequent comparisons examine how annotations, typography, and repeated detail accompany different rating outcomes. These extrema rank images under the configured rubric, and the illustrative selections do not estimate the prevalence of design patterns across the corpus.
blocks.zh: 修订可以使申诉更加明确,而不改进其内容。 以下案例将这种区别与个体数字的明显变化联系起来. 表7用六分制后平均值确定绝对分数。 随后的比较考察说明,打字和重复的细节如何与不同的评级结果相配合. 这些外观图像在所配置的标题下排列,说明性选择并不估计整个主体中设计模式的普遍程度。

blocks.en: Table 7: Absolute score extrema selected by the post hoc six-dimension mean. Entry 163 F is the unique maximum within the original set and within the accepted-revision set. Entry 128 M is the unique original minimum, while 136 F and 195 F tie for the accepted-revision minimum. Vectors follow ( C , O , G , A , I , S ) (C,O,G,A,I,S) , and means and changes are computed before rounding. These ranks concern model-rated figures, not the scientific quality of their papers.
blocks.zh: 表7: 绝对分数 绝对分数 绝对分数 绝对分数 绝对分数 第163 F项是原设定和接受修改设定中的独特上限。 第128 M项是独特的原始最小值,而接受修正的最低值为136 F和195 F的平局。 矢量跟随(C、O、G、A、I、S)(C、O、G、A、I、S),在四舍五入前计算出手段和变化。 这些排名涉及的都是模型级人物,而不是其论文的科学质量.

blocks.en: AccessWorld, the highest-rated original, organizes its explanation around a repeated task (Fig. 7 A) [ 53 ] . The upper panel connects the task, agent, assistive-technology interface, applications, and grading process. The lower panel compares interaction modes through corresponding examples. Its original mean is 4.83. The revision preserves this arrangement and explicitly labels the grading connection. Clarity increases to 5, bringing the six-dimension mean to 5.00. Although all six medians reach the maximum, the 18 individual ratings are not unanimously 5. Its membership in the contrast sample also demonstrates that the conventions used for purposive selection are compatible with highly rated visual communication.
blocks.zh: AccessWorld,收视率最高的原创作品,围绕重复的任务组织解释(图7 A)[53]. 上层面板连接任务,代理,辅助技术接口,应用程序,以及分级过程. 下面板通过相应的示例比较交互模式. 其最初的平均值为4.83. 修订保留了这一安排,并明确标注了分级连接。 清晰度增至5,使六分法的平均值达到5.00. 尽管所有6个中位数都达到了最高点,但18个个人的收视率并不是一致的5. 其作为对照样本的成员还表明,用于有目的选择的公约与高度评级的视觉交流是相符的。

blocks.en: The lowest-rated original illustrates the importance of making an intended comparison explicit. The over-segmentation motivation figure shows overlapping proposals, small instances, and part-biased support, but provides little explanation beyond panel letters (Fig. 7 B) [ 54 ] . The revision names these contrasts, defines the boxes and confidence values, and explains why a high-confidence fragment can be selected instead of the whole object. Clarity increases from 2 to 4 and specificity from 3 to 5. The mean rises from 2.67 to 4.33, yielding the largest paired increase ( + 1.67 +1.67 ). Information previously confined to the caption becomes available to the image-only judge, so the gain cannot be attributed to layout alone.
blocks.zh: 评级最低的原文说明,必须明确打算进行比较。 过于分化的动机图显示提案重叠,实例少,部分偏向支持,但除了面板字母(图7 B)[54]之外,几乎没有提供什么解释. 修改后的名称这些对比,定义了框和置信值,并解释了为什么可以选择一个高度自信的片段而不是整个对象. 清晰度从2提高到4,特异性从3提高到5. 平均增长率从2.67升至4.33,得出了最大的对称增长(+1.67+1.67 ) 。 以前限制在标题上的信息会提供给只使用图像的法官,因此收益不能仅仅归因于布局。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Absolute original-score extrema and their revisions. AccessWorld (163 F) is the unique original maximum, and the over-segmentation example (128 M) is the unique original minimum. Both were identified after scoring using the six-median average. Images are reproduced in full, with three-request median scores in C/O/G/A/I/S order. Original artwork is credited to the cited papers, and revisions are study-generated derivatives.
blocks.zh: 图7:绝对原得分上限及其订正。 AccessWorld(163 F)是独有的原创极限,过分分化的例子(128 M)是独有的原创极限. 两者都是在使用六中平均值评分后确定的。 图像完全复制,以C/O/G/A/I/S顺序的3个要求中位数. 原始艺术品记入所引用的论文,订正是研究产生的衍生作品。

blocks.en: Additional explanation does not necessarily resolve a difficult underlying arrangement. ReTax-Seg and Stride share the lowest accepted revised mean of 3.00 (Fig. 8 ). ReTax-Seg retains all six medians after explanatory guidance is appended to its dense feature and prior-related pathways [ 55 ] . Stride’s mean decreases from 3.50 to 3.00, with specificity remaining at 5 and organization, aesthetic coherence, and inventiveness each decreasing by one point [ 56 ] . These outcomes distinguish the presence of problem-specific content from the effectiveness of its organization.
blocks.zh: 附加解释不一定解决一项困难的基本安排。 ReTax-Seg 和 Stride 共用最低接受的订正平均值3.00(图8 )。 ReTax-Seg在解释性指导附在其密集特征和先前相关路径之后保留了所有六个中位数[55]. 斯特里德的平均值从3.50下降到3.00,特异性保持在5,组织性、审美一致性和发明性都下降了1点[56]。 这些成果将特定问题内容的存在与其组织的有效性区分开来。

blocks.en: The largest decline occurs in a different case. The continual-adaptation motivation figure decreases from 4.17 to 3.17 [ 21 ] . Adaptation and pruning annotations supplement its weather and driving examples, while white restoration patches interrupt the colored model panels. Organization decreases from 5 to 3 and aesthetic coherence from 4 to 3. The lowest revised scores and the largest score decrease therefore identify different figures.
blocks.zh: 最大的下降发生在另一个情况。 持续适应动机数字从4.17降至3.17[21]。 适应和刷新说明补充了它的天气和驱动实例,而白色修复补丁则中断了彩色模型面板. 组织从5个减少到3个,美学一致性从4个减少到3个。 因此,订正分数最低和降分数最大者发现的数字不同。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : The two accepted revisions tied for the lowest six-score mean (3.00). ReTax-Seg (136 F) retains all six medians, while Stride (195 F) loses one point each in organization, aesthetic coherence, and inventiveness. Selection is post hoc and illustrative. Full images and three-request median scores are shown. Original artwork is credited to the cited papers.
blocks.zh: 图8:接受的两项订正与最低的六分球平均数(3.00)挂钩。 ReTax-Seg(136 F)保留了全部6个中位数,而Stride(195 F)在组织,美学一致性和发明性方面各损失1分. 选择是特设的和说明性的。 完整图像和三个请求的中位数显示。 原始艺术品记入上述文件。

blocks.en: The typographic comparisons illustrate limited coordination between added emphasis and an existing visual hierarchy (Fig. 9 ). Complexity Experts adds bold headings that repeat the retained Dense Model and MoE labels, thick panel frames, and explanatory prose below the network comparisons [ 25 ] . Clarity increases from 3 to 4, but organization decreases from 5 to 4 and inventiveness from 4 to 3. Aesthetic coherence remains at 4. VEvo-Harness replaces an integrated brush-like title with a conventional title, subtitle, and matching heading strips, while varied lettering remains within the retained panels [ 52 ] . Clarity and specificity improve, but organization and aesthetic coherence remain at 3. These cases concern the integration of headings, technical labels, and annotations across the composition. A uniform outer treatment can make the message more explicit while leaving the internal hierarchy unresolved.
blocks.zh: 排版比较表明,增加的重点与现有视觉层次之间的协调有限(图9)。 复杂度专家增加了粗体标题,重复了保留下来的Dense Model和MOE标签,厚厚的面板框,以及网络比较下面的解释性表述[25]. 明确性从3个增加到4个,但组织从5个减少到4个,创新性从4个减少到3个。 美学一致性仍为4. VEvo-Harness用常规标题,字幕,和匹配的标题条来取代一个类似笔刷的集成标题,而保留面板内则保留不同的字母写法[52]. 清晰度和具体性有所提高,但组织和审美一致性仍保持在3。 这些案件涉及将标题、技术标签和说明纳入整个构成。 统一的外部处理可以使信息更加明确,同时使内部等级问题得不到解决。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Typographic changes in two motivation figures (062 M and 198 M). Added headings repeat retained labels in Complexity Experts. A conventional title and matching heading strips replace the integrated title treatment in VEvo-Harness. C, O, G, A, I, and S denote clarity, organization, graphical consistency, aesthetic coherence, inventiveness, and specificity. Scores are three-request medians, and changes are computed before display rounding. Images are shown in full. Original artwork is credited to the cited papers, and revisions are study-generated derivatives.
blocks.zh: 图9:两种动机数字的字型变化(062 M和198 M)。 添加的标题重复复杂度专家中保留的标签。 常规标题和匹配标题条取代VEvo-Harness的综合标题处理. C、O、G、A、I和S表示清晰度、组织性、图形一致性、审美一致性、发明性和特异性。 分数是三个请求的中位数,变化在显示四舍五入前计算。 图像全显示. 原始艺术品记入所引用的论文,订正是研究产生的衍生作品。

blocks.en: BKBAgent illustrates the limits of adding explanation around an already elaborate visual argument (Fig. 10 ). Its dialogue, physical mechanisms, and knowledge base already combine substantial text with diagrams. The revision appends three connected explanation boxes and a summary sentence [ 47 ] . Clarity remains at 4 and organization at 3, while aesthetic coherence and inventiveness decrease from 4 to 3. The added reading layer leaves the main arrangement largely intact and produces no increase in the clarity median.
blocks.zh: BKBAgent说明了围绕一个已经很详尽的视觉论点(图10)增加解释的局限性。 它的对话、物理机制和知识基础已经将实质性文本与图表结合起来。 修订附件为三个相连的解释框和一个摘要句 [47]. 清晰度仍为4,组织性为3,而审美一致性和发明性则从4降至3. 添加的读数层让主安排基本完好,不会产生清晰度中位数的增加.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Added explanatory layers in BKBAgent (167 M). Three connected explanation boxes and a summary sentence extend the original composition. Clarity and organization remain unchanged, while aesthetic coherence and inventiveness each decrease by one point. Both images are shown in full, with three-request median scores in C/O/G/A/I/S order. Original artwork is credited to the cited paper, and the revision is a study-generated derivative.
blocks.zh: 图10:BKBAgent中添加的解释层(167 M). 三个相连的解释框和一个摘要句延长了原来的组成. 清晰度和组织性保持不变,而审美一致性和发明性则每减少一点。 这两幅图像均以完整显示,以C/O/G/A/I/S顺序显示三个请求中位数. 原作作品记入所引用的论文,修订稿是研究产生的衍生作品.

blocks.en: Repeating an existing region creates a related challenge of coordinating detail with the overall structure (Fig. 11 ). Look Before You Restore places a reduced overview above an enlarged panel for state and action encoding. The detail heading is more prominent than the overall title, and organization decreases from 4 to 3 [ 42 ] . Stride similarly places an enlarged champion-evolution region beside a smaller complete workflow [ 56 ] . The tool, image, and award pictograms already appear in the original figures. These revisions repeat source content at different scales, making the selection and integration of detail central to their composition. The observations do not isolate typography, duplication, or scale as causes of the rating changes.
blocks.zh: 重复一个现有的区域,会产生与总体结构协调细节的相关挑战(图11)。 在您恢复前, 请将一个缩小的概览放在一个扩大的面板之上, 用于状态和动作编码 。 详细标题比总标题更为突出,组织从4个减少到3个[42]。 类似地,将扩大的冠军-革命区域置于一个较小的完整工作流程之外[56]。 工具、图像和授予象形图已经在原始数字中出现。 这些修改在不同尺度上重复了源内容,使得细节的选择和整合成为其组成的核心. 观测结果并不将打字、重复或比例作为评级变化的原因加以隔离。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Repeated content in two framework revisions (147 F and 195 F). Enlarged details duplicate regions retained in the complete overviews, repeating existing labels and pictograms. Organization decreases in both cases. Images are fitted individually without cropping, preserving their differing canvas proportions. Scores are three-request medians in C/O/G/A/I/S order. Original artwork is credited to the cited papers, and revisions are study-generated derivatives.
blocks.zh: 图11:两次框架订正中重复的内容(147 F和195 F)。 扩大的细节重复了完整概览中保留的区域,重复了现有的标签和象形图. 在这两种情况下,组织都减少了。 图像是单独装配的,没有裁剪,保持其不同的画布比例。 分数是C/O/G/A/I/S顺序中的三个要求中位数. 原始艺术品记入所引用的论文,订正是研究产生的衍生作品。

blocks.en: Annotation is more useful when it identifies a specific missing correspondence (Fig. 12 ). SegEarth-OV3 labels the input image, transformer-decoder output, and semantic-segmentation output and explains their contrasts [ 32 ] . Five dimensions increase by one point while aesthetic coherence remains at 4. PULSE adds a question headline, stronger red emphasis, and explanatory notes [ 38 ] . Clarity increases from 4 to 5, but aesthetic coherence decreases from 5 to 4. These outcomes frame restraint as a functional design decision. An addition should contribute necessary meaning while fitting the surrounding visual hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 注释在识别具体缺失的函文时(图12)更有用. SegEarth-OV3标注了输入图像,变压器-解码器输出,以及语义-分区输出,并解释了它们的对比[32]. 五维增一分,而美学一致性仍为四. PULSE增加了一个问题标题,更强烈的红色强调,以及解释性说明[38]. 清晰度从4提高到5,但审美一致性从5降至4. 这些成果将限制规定为职能设计决定。 增加的内容应有助于必要的意义,同时适应周围的视觉结构。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Contrasting annotation outcomes in motivation figures (100 M and 127 M). SegEarth-OV3 gains in five dimensions while retaining its aesthetic score. PULSE gains one clarity point and loses one aesthetic point, leaving the six-score mean unchanged. Images are shown in full, with three-request median scores in C/O/G/A/I/S order. Original artwork is credited to the cited papers, and revisions are study-generated derivatives.
blocks.zh: 图12:动机数字的注释结果对比(100兆和127兆)。 SegEarth-OV3在保留其美学分的同时在五个维度上有所收获. PULSE获得1个清晰点,失去1个美学点,使得6分的平均值不变. 图像完整显示,以C/O/G/A/I/S顺序显示3个请求中位数. 原始艺术品记入所引用的论文,订正是研究产生的衍生作品。

blocks.en: Compositional judgment remains distinct from the fidelity review described in Section 4.3 . The rejected Make It Up framework changes an update relation, while the rejected EAGLE motivation figure misroutes image inputs [ 57 , 58 ] . Neither receives revision quality scores. Passing the recorded fidelity checks is a prerequisite for quality assessment, but accepted revisions can still lose organization or aesthetic coherence. The clarity and coherence of the resulting composition therefore require separate judgment.
blocks.zh: 组成判决仍然不同于第4.3节所述的忠诚审查。 被否决的Make It Up框架更改了更新关系,而被否决的EAGLE动机图将图像输入[57,58]错序. 也没有获得修订质量分数。 通过记录的忠诚度检查是质量评估的先决条件,但接受的修订仍可能失去组织或美学一致性。 因此,由此产生的组成的明确性和一致性需要单独的判断。

blocks.en: 5.6 Reliability and Scope of Interpretation
blocks.zh: 5.6 解释的可靠性和范围

blocks.en:
Repeated judgments show substantial agreement under the fixed protocol. All three scores agree in 1,897 of 2,226 original figure–dimension cells (85.2%) and 1,938 of 2,214 revised cells (87.5%). Every remaining cell spans one integer point, indicating repeat stability within the configured procedure.
The results distinguish explicit information from effective organization. Motivation figures receive larger average rating gains than frameworks, with inspected cases linking clarified comparisons to higher clarity scores. Framework revisions can retain high specificity while losing visual coherence. Added explanations may leave hierarchies unresolved or repeat detail without clarifying structure. These findings characterize the complete workflow, including generation, source-content preservation, and annotation informed by the same judge. Each revision should therefore serve the figure’s explanatory purpose and preserve scientific relationships, with consolidation and omission considered alongside elaboration.
blocks.zh:
一再作出的判决表明,根据固定协议,双方基本一致。 所有三个得分都同意在2,226个原始数字-二元细胞中的1,897个(85.2%)和2,214个修订细胞中的1,938个(87.5%。 每个剩余单元格跨一个整数点,表明在配置的程序内重复稳定。
结果将明确的信息与有效的组织区分开来。 动机数字得到的平均评级收益大于框架,所检查的案例将澄清的比较与更高的清晰度分数联系起来。 框架修改可以保持高度的特异性,同时失去视觉一致性. 增加的解释可能使等级问题得不到解决或重复细节,而不澄清结构。 这些调查结果是整个工作流程的特点,包括生成、源内容保存以及由同一法官提供的说明。 因此,每次修订都应符合该数字的解释性目的,并保持科学关系,同时考虑合并和遗漏。

blocks.en: 6 Concerns and Outlook
blocks.zh: 6 关注和展望

blocks.en: The observed tradeoffs raise a broader question about how scientific visual communication should be evaluated when models contribute to both its production and assessment. The following considerations connect the findings to design practice and examine possible implications for scholarly evaluation and future model development.
blocks.zh: 观察到的权衡提出了更广泛的问题,即当模型有助于其制作和评估时,应如何评价科学视觉通信。 以下考虑将研究结果与设计做法联系起来,并审查对学术评价和今后模型开发可能产生的影响。

blocks.en: I) From figure scores to reviewing decisions. Evidence of LLM-assisted review writing [ 59 ] motivates investigating whether multimodal assistance could influence how reviewers interpret scientific figures. If reviewers consult MLLMs, revisions that receive higher figure ratings could also affect their recommendations. Such changes might reflect clearer scientific communication, sensitivity to favored visual conventions, or both. Our six dimensions, however, define an image-assessment rubric. They do not characterize the preferences of all reviewing models or establish how figures contribute to full-paper assessments. Whether figure-level gains transfer to reviewer recommendations therefore remains an untested hypothesis. Its practical significance should be examined through reader understanding and the reasons supporting a recommendation, alongside changes in numerical ratings.
blocks.zh: 一) 从数字分数到审查决定。 由LLM协助编写评论的证据[59]促使人们调查多式联运援助是否会影响审查者如何解释科学数字。 如果审查人员查阅最低劳动标准,获得较高评级的修订也会影响其建议。 这种变化可能反映更明确的科学交流、对偏好的视觉公约的敏感性或两者兼而有之。 然而,我们的六个方面界定了一个图像评估主题。 它们没有说明所有审查模式的偏好,也没有确定数字如何有助于全面评估。 因此,是否将数字水平的收益转移给审查人员的建议仍然是一个未经测试的假设。 应当通过读者的理解和支持建议的理由,以及数字评级的变化,来研究其实际意义。

blocks.en: II) When evaluation criteria become design targets. A rubric can guide revision, but repeated optimization against its scores may favor features that an evaluator readily recognizes. Headings, labels, and familiar layouts can clarify relationships. Applied indiscriminately, they can also become formulas that receive insufficient adaptation to the figure’s purpose. In this study, the same judge configuration supplied feedback for revision and evaluated the resulting figures. Such a loop may also amplify biases reported for text-based LLM judges [ 60 ] . Even inventiveness risks becoming formulaic if evaluators reward familiar visual cues as evidence of creativity.
blocks.zh: 二) 当评价标准成为设计目标时。 标题可以指导修订,但对照其分数反复优化可能有利于评价人员容易识别的特性。 标题,标签,和熟悉的布局可以澄清关系. 不加区别地应用,它们也可以成为对数字目的调整不充分的公式。 在这项研究中,同一法官配置为修订提供了反馈,并评价了由此产生的数字。 这种循环还可能扩大报告给基于文本的LLM法官的偏见[60]。 如果评价人员奖励熟悉的视觉提示作为创造力的证据,即使发明也有可能成为公式。

blocks.en: III) Visual conformity and dependence on model versions. A possible feedback loop connects design choices, scholarly visibility, and subsequent model development. Authors may adopt compositions favored by model-assisted assessments. These compositions could become more visible and widely imitated, then reappear in training data or tool templates that reinforce the same conventions. In the most pessimistic scenario, the literature becomes visually polished but narrower in its explanatory forms, with unfamiliar yet effective representations receiving less recognition. Reliance on a few services could also expose authors to changing preferences across model versions, prompts, and deployment settings. Design effort might increasingly be directed toward satisfying opaque evaluators, potentially favoring authors with greater resources for repeated optimization. Versioned reference collections and longitudinal audits could reveal how rankings of the same figures change as evaluators evolve.
blocks.zh: 三)视觉兼容性和对模型版本的依赖. 一个可能的反馈循环将设计选择、学术能见度和随后的模型开发联系起来。 作者可采用模型辅助评估所赞成的构成。 这些组成可以更加明显和广泛模仿,然后重新出现在强化这些公约的培训数据或工具模板中。 在最悲观的情景中,文献在视觉上被抛光,但在解释性形式上变得狭窄,不熟悉但有效的表述获得的认可较少。 依赖一些服务也可能使作者在模型版本、提示和部署设置中面临改变偏好的情况。 设计工作可能越来越多地着眼于满足不透明的评估者,可能有利于作者获得更多的资源来重复优化。 版本的参考文献汇编和纵向审计可以揭示,随着评价人员的发展,同一数字的排名如何变化。

blocks.en: IV) Independent validation of communication and diversity. Future experiments should compare original figures, reader-oriented revisions, and evaluator-oriented revisions under matched scientific content and information quantity. Distinguishing layout changes from caption-derived explanation would clarify what a rating increase represents. Independent models could assess complete paper variants, while targeted reader studies measure recovery of intended relationships, comprehension accuracy, reading time, and preference. Held-out model families and versions would test whether gains transfer beyond the evaluator that informed revision. Comparisons between human-only and model-assisted assessments would help examine effects on reviewer recommendations. Studies of stylistic convergence additionally require explicit measures of layout, visual encodings, and spatial organization within comparable topics and figure roles. Fidelity failures and unfavorable changes should remain part of the reported outcomes.
blocks.zh: 四,独立验证沟通与多样性. 今后的试验应在相应的科学内容和信息数量下比较原始数字、面向读者的修订和评价者的修订。 将布局变化与标题衍生的解释区分开来,可以澄清提高评级意味着什么。 独立模型可以评估完整的纸张变体,而目标读者研究则衡量预期关系的恢复、理解准确性、阅读时间和偏好。 被搁置的模型家庭和版本将检验收益转让是否超出有参考依据的修订评价者。 将仅人力评估与模型辅助评估进行比较将有助于审查对审查者建议的影响。 对结构趋同的研究,还需要在可比专题和图中明确衡量布局、视觉编码和空间组织。 忠于职守的失败和不利的改变仍应是所报告的结果的一部分。

blocks.en: V) Human alignment for future self-improving systems. Routine model updates should not be equated with recursive self-improvement (RSI). For future systems that participate in improving their own capabilities and improvement mechanisms, progress in scientific visualization should be evaluated against evidence beyond their own scores. A constructive process would combine diverse design proposals, targeted human feedback, and independent fidelity checks. Alignment with human aesthetic judgments should accommodate differences across disciplines, expertise, cultures, and accessibility needs, including reasonable disagreement about effective expression. Optimizing a single aggregate preference score could marginalize useful but less common approaches. Evaluation should therefore consider comprehension, reading effort, and recognition of effective unfamiliar designs alongside aesthetic preference. Human evidence should also remain capable of revising the objectives that guide improvement.
blocks.zh: 五,人与人结合未来自我完善体系. 常规模型更新不应等同于递归自我改进(RSI). 对于今后参与提高自身能力和改进机制的系统,科学可视化方面的进展应当根据超出自身分数的证据进行评估. 一个建设性进程将把各种设计建议、有针对性的人类反馈和独立忠诚度检查结合起来。 与人的审美判断保持一致,应顾及学科、专门知识、文化和无障碍需求之间的差异,包括对有效表达的合理分歧。 优化单一的汇总优惠分数可能会将有用但不太常见的办法边缘化。 因此,评价应考虑理解、阅读努力和承认有效的不熟悉的设计以及美学偏好。 人类证据还应仍然能够修订指导改进的目标。

blocks.en: VI) Human authority as a practical design requirement. Researchers should retain control over a figure’s explanatory purpose and composition, together with responsibility for its scientific relationships. This includes deciding when clarification requires an additional annotation and when it requires consolidation or removal. Reviewers and editors should likewise retain responsibility for judgments of validity, novelty, and significance, supported by reasons that can be examined independently of model scores. Tools should support these decisions by preserving editable sources, exposing semantic changes, and reporting uncertainty and dimensional tradeoffs. Authors must remain able to reject a highly rated revision or defend an effective composition that a model undervalues. Assistance is most useful when it makes these decisions easier to inspect, revise, and defend.
blocks.zh: 六) 人的权威是实际设计的要求。 研究人员应保留对数字解释目的和构成的控制权,并负责其科学关系。 这包括决定何时需要补充说明,何时需要合并或删除。 同样,评论员和编辑应保留对有效性、新颖性和重要性的判断责任,并附上可以独立于模型分数审查的理由。 各种工具应通过保留可编辑来源、揭露语义变化以及报告不确定性和维度权衡来支持这些决定。 作者必须仍然能够拒绝高度评级的修订,或为模型低估的有效构成辩护。 如果援助使这些决定更容易检查、修改和捍卫,则援助最有用。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This study examines scientific visual communication through a documented corpus and source-constrained revisions. Within the collected sample, model ratings show no uniform historical decline. Revisions receive higher clarity ratings on average but lower aesthetic-coherence ratings, revealing tradeoffs that a single score can conceal. These findings inform our argument for researcher-led design, in which AI expands the available alternatives and authors determine what to emphasize, what to omit, and how to preserve scientific meaning. As models participate in both production and assessment, their judgments should remain accountable to human understanding. The nights recalled in our title matter for the care invested in giving an idea a visual form. As crafting figures becomes easier, the responsibility to decide what is worth showing remains ours.
blocks.zh: 这项研究通过有文件证明的书目和受来源限制的修订来审查科学的视觉交流。 在所收集的样本中,模型评分显示没有统一的历史下降. 修订平均获得较高的清晰度评级,但审美一致性评级较低,揭示了单个得分可以隐瞒的权衡. 这些结论为我们关于研究人员主导设计的论点提供了依据,其中AI扩展了可用的替代品,作者们决定强调什么,忽略什么,以及如何保留科学意义. 由于模型既参与生产也参与评估,其判断仍应对人类的理解负责。 夜里在标题上回忆起 关心给一个想法 一种视觉形式。 随着数字的制作变得更加容易,决定哪些东西值得展示的责任仍然是我们的责任。
